title: Every “No” from Man is a Setup for God’s Better
paragraphs: Every “No” from Man is a Setup for God’s Better

When man says “no,” don’t lose faith.
Sometimes rejection isn’t the end — it’s redirection.
God’s silence doesn’t mean absence. It means He’s working on something greater than what you asked for.
💭 What if that closed door was really God protecting your purpose?
🔥 Hold on. Your “no” is just the setup for your divine breakthrough.

“For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.”
— Jeremiah 29:11 (NIV)
